env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos build -o $WORK/lib.a ./lib
go tool pack p $WORK/lib.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn Box\.Pure Readonly,ParamMutated=0$'
stdout '^fn Summer\.Pure Readonly$'

logos build -o $WORK/ok.a ./okcall
! logos build -o $WORK/bad.a ./badcall
stderr 'const_view_mutation.*cannot pass argument through const view'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/readonly

go 1.27

-- w/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Box struct {
	V []int
}

func (b Box) Pure(xs const []int) int {
	total := 0
	for _, v := range xs {
		total += v
	}
	return total
}

type Summer interface {
	const Pure(xs []int) int
}

-- w/okcall/ok.lgo --
package okcall

import "example.com/readonly/lib"

func Use(b lib.Box, cv const []int) int {
	return b.Pure(cv)
}

-- w/badcall/bad.lgo --
package badcall

import "example.com/readonly/lib"

func Use(s lib.Summer, cv const []int) int {
	return s.Pure(cv)
}
